statusMeaning.merged: On main. Every path in files and tests must exist and every prerequisite must also be merged.
statusMeaning.in-review: Complete on a branch with an open pull request; pr names it. Paths are not checked on this branch.
statusMeaning.todo: Not started. Paths are the plan's intent, not a promise about names.
statusMeaning.removed: Withdrawn from the design; the reason is in note.

clarityIteration2_20260930.scope: Iteration 2 toward beating LeapEdge on PM clarity (goal set by the user 30 Sep). Page (code only): an 'At a glance' line grouping idea tickers by action; the sentiment table becomes 'Also discussed' (only instruments without a card, resolved, with a non-neutral stance, at most 5; everything else one 'Also mentioned' line of resolved names); key points exclude the summary and, when cards exist, action/holding sentences, at most 7; summary prefers the creator's own view, skips sentences opening with a connective, video order; market caps are not levels; a catalyst said twice appears once; one third party's views on several tickers are one card; a translation whose numbers differ from the original is not shown; quotes cut to about 180 characters and shown as the checked English translation; numbers, themes and 'not stated' leave the note. Prompt evidence-first.web.v10 (v9 plus rules on level roles, open vs closed trades, hedged conviction, waiting vs avoiding, speakers, and hold/break technical levels). The critic may return corrected_conviction on an accepted item; the pipeline only ever lowers conviction and records it (convictionCorrections), so a call is no longer lost when only its conviction was overstated.

clarityIteration2E_20260930.scope: Iteration 2E toward beating LeapEdge on PM clarity. When the team setting processing.bottomLine is on (absent means off, so earlier request hashes and call counts are unchanged), after the research brief is stored one small extraction-model call (synthesis-bottom-line) condenses the audited brief sentences and the accepted ideas into two or three sentences leading with the creator's thesis. A deterministic check (checkBottomLine) keeps a sentence only when every number, quantity word and name in it appears in the statements it cites; rejected sentences are recorded on the run (bottomLineRejected), a failure is recorded (bottomLineError) and never fails the brief. The analyst view uses the kept sentences as its summary, falls back to the brief's own sentences without them, and drops statements the bottom line condensed from the key points. The writeBottomLine action backfills an existing brief. Card headers omit a stance that only restates the action (Watching · watch, Holding · hold).

functionRegion20261001.scope: Move Vercel functions from syd1 to iad1, beside the database the app connects to. PR 28's status probe measured a 221 ms database round trip from syd1, which matches Sydney to US east and contradicts the old note that the Neon project is in ap-southeast-2. Each query pays that round trip, and a page makes 8–19 of them. With functions beside the database each query costs a millisecond or two, and the browser pays one long-haul trip per request instead. Reversible by changing vercel.json back; moving the database to Sydney instead is the alternative and is the user's decision.
